Imagine a collection of teddy bears that redefine adorable with a bold twist: cute on the outside, swashbuckling on the inside.

Each teddy bear is made from high-quality materials and features a look that ranges from cute to rebellious. Its details and accessories capture a provocative style, combining sweetness and daring attitude. The harnesses are made of soft leather and lace straps, fitting their petite figures impeccably. They wear masks that cover part of their faces, giving them a mysterious and charming air. The gags, in vibrant shades, add a bold and playful touch, while small chains wrap around their plush bodies, adding texture and a striking visual effect.

A teddy bear with a bold and original style, which includes a hanger so you can carry it with you in your bag, backpack or favorite accessory. Perfect for those looking for something different and with personality. Make this teddy bear a unique companion anywhere!

Each of the bears has a particular accessory: Yogi wears handcuffs with a chain; Ted stands out for his whip and mask and his custom harness; Fozzie , the most rebellious, sports a dark gag and metallic details on his clothing; Bongowears a sleek ring harness; Mishka, wearing a bunny-eared mask with matching leg chains and harness, represents softness and style; and Winnie, always ready for adventure, carries her petite body on ropes.

These six models are collectible, so you can make each one a part of your world and have the complete FETISH SUBMISSIVE collection, where “cute” and rebellious meet in perfect balance.
